key_insight: An LLM agent coordinated changes across about 1,650 CAD parameters to reduce a magnesium stent’s high-percentile bend strain by 32% within 15 nonlinear simulations.
engineering_relevance: Simulation-guided AI could enable substantial component redesign when nonlinear finite-element solves are costly and the CAD design space is large.
method: GPT-6 Astra proposed edits to the stent’s CAD geometry.
Each proposal was built, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact.
The agent used full simulation results to guide subsequent edits.
evidence_signal: Under the same 15-simulation budget, Tosca improved the objective by about 10%; an earlier AI design independently evaluated through full deployment showed 14% lower strain and 63% less damage at the most damaged spot.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to one component, and the independent higher-fidelity validation tested an earlier design rather than the final 32%-improved design.
paper_title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
